notes: Vanilla canvas 2D, zero libraries. Sunset palette with a big low sun, stars, and drifting clouds. Parallax layers from far to near: far ridge, mid hills, near ground, seeded conifer/round treeline, roadside props (streetlights with glow, utility poles with sagging wires, bushes, rocks + sign), road with scrolling dashes, edge lines, asphalt flecks and a sun-reflection smear, near-foreground swaying grass at 1.35x. Scenery is deterministic per tile index (seeded sin hash), so the loop is seamless but varied. Car: coupe silhouette with gradient body, sunset rim light, reflective glass, rolling 5-spoke wheels synced to road distance (true rolling, no slip), independent suspension bob/pitch driven by layered road noise, headlight beam, taillight glow, exhaust puffs, soft shadow. Cinematic letterbox bars, vignette, and animated film grain. Verified headless (Node + validating canvas stub, 900 frames, no exceptions); verification caught and fixed one first-frame crash (car.scale read as a property instead of called -> NaN ellipse radii, which discarded every frame's canvas work).
